headline: Volume and lead value both gave way: $1,773 on half last Wednesday's spend
commentary:
### The day
- **$1,773 NP at 7.8% margin** — the day barely paid for itself.
  - NP: $1,773 v $7,548 last Wed
  - Cost: $20,959 v $36,387
- Lead value finished **below the eight-Wednesday floor**, and volume did too.
  - EPL: $11.35 v $14.46 lowest of eight
  - Leads: 2,003 v 2,269 lowest of eight
- Second-weakest profit day of the last fortnight, but the month still looks fine.
  - MTD NP: $151,064 v $137,425 last month
  - MTD NM: 14.4% v 10.5%
### What drove it
- Search ran at a small loss on half the spend.
  - Search NP: -$363 v +$5,382 last Wed
  - Search cost: $14,518 v $30,415
  - Search EPL: $23.17 v $28.60
- Impression share dropped hard in our two biggest spenders; rivals took it.
  - amount IS: 20.9% v 36.1%
  - payday_alternative IS: 15.3% v 24.8%
  - albert.com account IS: 39.3% v 34.7%
- We also sat lower on the page all evening.
  - 19:00 abs-top: 6.1% v 12.3%
  - 20:00 abs-top: 6.4% v 12.9%
- Both main trees were well down, so this is broad weakness.
  - Direct (Inc ZP) EPL: $14.71 v $20.85 last seven
  - Test tree EPL: $13.15 v $21.52 last seven
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 28/10 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SAs to ROAS targets | competitor on tROAS | $265 | $681 | — |
| speed walk-down | high target, stepping down | $154 | $1,043 | — |
| Scavenger pair | tROAS v tCPA copy | $975 | $1,161 | — |
- Speed is held back by a deliberately high target, so thin spend is expected.
  - speed cost: $154 v $1,043
- The scavengers are there to hoover up cheap clicks; off at weekends.
  - Scavenger CPCs: $3.16 and $4.06
watch: Impression share in amount and payday_alternative, and whether 20.9% and 15.3% climb back toward last week's levels.
EPL over the next few days — $11.35 sits under the eight-Wednesday low, and two or three more like it make it a level rather than a bad day.
Bing, which spent half again more at $4,646 and came out $109 under water on a $10.63 EPL.
